title: Attendee · Create an incident
caption: The attendee describes a fictional ankle injury and keeps “Use my location”. The recording sandbox supplies fictional GPS.

title: Attendee · Report received
caption: I-1 is saved. “Send report only” does not automatically request a volunteer; Mo can offer the incident manually.

title: Mo · New incident on the map
caption: The same incident appears as an orange pin beside Priya’s blue volunteer pin. Mo opens I-1 from the map.

title: Mo · Offer to Priya
caption: Mo reviews the original report, chooses available Priya and sends an offer.

title: Volunteer · Incoming offer
caption: Priya receives the incident details and destination. She has Accept and Decline controls.

title: Volunteer · Accept the assignment
caption: Priya accepts. The server assigns I-1 to her and marks her busy. Arrival still needs confirmation.

title: Volunteer · Grey dotted connection
caption: The volunteer’s field map draws a decorative dotted curve between the starting ping and attendee.

title: Mo · Start fictional movement
caption: Mo starts the existing 90-second movement demo. This is simulated movement, not real phone GPS.

title: Volunteer · Journey begins
caption: Priya’s simulated moving pin advances. The grey dotted path starts gaining white fill.

title: Volunteer · White progress advances
caption: White centres extend along the same dotted curve as the simulated volunteer approaches.

title: Volunteer · Approaching the destination
caption: The replay skips time between captured frames of the real app’s 90-second simulation.

title: Volunteer · Full white progress
caption: The backend reaches 100% and the dotted connection is filled white. The incident remains open.

title: Mo · Same journey visible
caption: Mo sees the incident, volunteer and completed decorative progress in the operations map.

title: Attendee · Private responder tracking
caption: The attendee sees the frozen volunteer starting ping and white progress, without the volunteer’s moving pin.

title: Volunteer · Human confirmation remains
caption: At 100%, Priya still has “Mark arrived”. Movement never automatically confirms arrival or resolves the incident.
